title: George Washington Carver and Useful Abundance
short_teaser: George Washington Carver studied crops and soil at a time when Southern farmland had been exhausted by repeated cotton planting.
story: George Washington Carver studied crops and soil at a time when Southern farmland had been exhausted by repeated cotton planting. He promoted crop rotation and explored practical uses for alternative crops. Innovation can restore a system by valuing resources that have been overlooked. A person’s story becomes useful when it helps us recognize choices, courage, persistence, and possibility in our own life. The lasting value is not merely knowing the fact. It is seeing the pattern beneath it and considering where that same pattern may already be present in ordinary life, creative work, or business.
